stem: Draw the straight line through $A({=x1}, {=y1})$ and $B({=x2}, {=y2})$.
solution: Put one handle on $A$ and the other on $B$.
Its gradient is $\frac{{=y2 - y1}}{{=x2 - x1}} = {=Fraction(y2 - y1, x2 - x1)}$.
